# fal-image-mcp-fv

> Remote MCP server for fal.ai image models. Connect to Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client and generate, edit, upscale, resize, or outpaint images with curated models and per-call cost tracking. Deploy to Vercel in one click.

## What it is

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives LLM clients (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code) the ability to work with fal.ai image models — 19 curated favorites covering text-to-image, edit, background removal, upscale, smart resize, and outpaint.

## Tools exposed

- fal_list_models: List curated favorite models and optionally search the public fal.ai catalog
- fal_generate_image: Generate an image from a text prompt using any favorite or custom fal endpoint
- fal_edit_image: Edit an existing image using a text prompt and 1+ reference image URLs
- fal_remove_background: Remove the background from an image, returning a transparent PNG (Pixelcut)
- fal_upscale: Upscale an image (default clarity-upscaler; cheaper esrgan-upscale)
- fal_resize: Smart resize/recompose to an exact width×height (default smart-resize)
- fal_outpaint: Expand/uncrop image borders (default flux-2-pro-outpaint)
- fal_session_cost: Show accumulated USD cost for the current session
- fal_model_info: Show pricing, capabilities, and defaults for a specific favorite model

## How to deploy

1. Click the Vercel deploy button on the GitHub repo
2. Set FAL_KEY (from fal.ai/dashboard/keys) and MCP_BEARER_TOKEN (any random string)
3. Add the deployed URL to your MCP client config
